interface.name: rix_toplevel_observer_manager_v1

description.summary: Observe a toplevel owned by the connecting process

interface.description: An optional compositor extension for positioning non-interactive overlays. The compositor selects the largest existing toplevel belonging to the process identified by the connection's peer credentials. Connections of other processes are never observed. No application names, process IDs or window titles are supplied by the client. This does not grant capture, input injection or window management permissions.

interface.name: rix_toplevel_observer_v1
interface.description: One state or unavailable event is sent when created, followed by events only when the state changes. The geometry is the client content rectangle, excluding compositor decorations, in global logical coordinates. A minimized or unfocused window is reported with active=0. active=0 is also enforced during session locking or when no output intersects the window. output names match wl_output.name. The output with the largest intersection is chosen. unavailable means no matching toplevel/output exists.

entry.name: invalid_role
entry.summary: overlay must have the layer-shell role

request.name: attach_overlay

description.summary: Show an overlay only while the observed window is active

request.description: The supplied layer-shell surface and its subsurfaces/popups are visible only when the observed toplevel is focused and mapped. Visibility is controlled by the compositor even if the client stops producing frames. Attach before committing the overlay's first buffer. Attaching does not change capture policy or input regions; use an empty input region for a passive overlay. Destroying the observer leaves its attached surfaces hidden. A later attachment replaces the previous observer for that surface.

request.name: detach_overlay
request.description: Only an attachment to this observer is removed.

arg.name: active
arg.summary: one when focused and visible, otherwise zero
